commitResults.messageTitle: Update list command to show the full student roster
commitResults.messageBody:
The MVP specification requires list to take no parameters, so that
users never mistake an unfiltered roster for a filtered one, and to
report how many students are shown.

Add ListCommandParser to reject any extra input with the list format
error, and report "{N} students listed!" with a singular form for one
student. Update the UG, DG acknowledgement and team context file.

Refs #46

The specification allows only surrounding ordinary spaces around list,
but trimming accepted tabs and line breaks as empty input. Pass list
its raw arguments and accept spaces only, with regression tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix list whitespace tests for non-ASCII spaces
commitResults.messageBody:
Non-ASCII spaces are not command-word separators, so input such as
list followed by a no-break space is rejected as an unknown command
rather than with the list format error. Assert the actual rejection.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enable assertions when running the app with Gradle
commitResults.messageBody:
Java disables assertions by default, and the Gradle run task did not
enable them, so assert statements in the application code were never
checked when running the app locally.

Enable assertions for the run task so that violated assumptions fail
fast during development.

Refs #68

The class view had no real-window tests for exact class matching,
attendance changes outside the viewed week or course, failed queries,
or repeated queries, so regressions there could go unnoticed.

Add ClassViewUiTest to check that find matches course and group
exactly, that badges show only the viewed course and week while the
details panel updates, that invalid queries keep the view, selection
and input, and that repeating a query gives the same result.

Refs #60

commitResults.messageTitle: Show attendance totals in the class view
commitResults.messageBody:
In a class view, TAs had to count the attendance badges themselves to
see how many students were present, absent or still unrecorded for
the week.

Add AttendanceSummary to count the decisions of a class's students for
one course and week, and show it below the roster heading in non-empty
class views. It updates when attendance is marked and is hidden on the
full roster. Document it in the UG and DG.
